steps.title: The challenge
steps.body: IoTech Protect is an independent security company that implements the latest physical and cyber security infrastructure protocols to ensure valued company assets are safe. IoTech Protect offers many different services and works across a broad spectrum of industries, creating breakthrough solutions that bring strong commercial value to clients and the benefits of high-level security to all. The challenge was in simplifying the communications for a service that is solving an invisible problem that many business owners don’t know they are facing. A broad spectrum of services for all types of industries.
steps.alt: IoTech Protect: a screen of the site as qwarter.com's case study shows it

steps.title: The solution
steps.body: IoTech Protect has built a community of strategic partnerships who can solve the security problems others can’t. To reinforce their position as an industry leader and global innovator, IoTech Protect engaged with QWARTER to redesign their brand and visual identity. Starting with this new audacious brand, QWARTER designed and developed an experience to affirm the company’s position by enriching the aspects of IoTech Protect that drive their innovative spirits: people and humanity. Since launch, engagement has increased significantly with 208% more page views, 54% more users, and an 89% increase in average session duration. Communicating specific problems businesses face and how IoTech’s community of strategic partnerships can solve problems others can’t. IoTech Protect — Protecting physical and digital infrastructure We began unpacking IoTech Protect’s brand which we found rooted in its mission to deliver solutions for the most pressing challenges in business continuity. “Needing to create a website and messaging that creates a space for physical, cyber and IoT security as well as a voice for B2B customers to understand the disruptive premise of cyber and physical threat. We felt it was a difficult brief to get right. But QWARTER responded so well, combining a highly original exploration with a completely collaborative process, resulting in a site that was creatively spirited and user-perfect. Nick Jaksa, CEO
